stories.summary: President Trump announced plans to impose significant penalties on U.S. tech companies that construct artificial intelligence data centers in foreign countries. He described these penalties as a 'tremendous tax' aimed at discouraging such practices and promoting domestic infrastructure development.

stories.summary: During a recent press briefing at the White House, Donald Trump criticized a reporter, calling her 'really a rude person' and suggesting she belonged in the 'back row.' This exchange occurred amid discussions about various topics, including a reported threat from Iran.

stories.title: Trump Addresses Relationship with Putin Amid Questions on US Friendship
stories.summary: Trump defended his characterization of Vladimir Putin as a friend but stated he could not comment on whether Putin is a friend to the United States. This response came during a recent interview where he sidestepped direct questions regarding the implications of his relationship with the Russian leader.

stories.title: Mayor Zohran Mamdani Injures Achilles Playing Soccer
stories.summary: New York City Mayor Zohran Mamdani suffered an Achilles tear while playing soccer against the NYC press corps. He will be using a walking boot for at least six weeks and was seen arriving at a press conference on crutches.
